name: term-server-agent-events
description: Reports Codex lifecycle and retained semantic history to its term-server session.

interface.shortDescription: Show live Codex activity and Supervisor history in term-server.
interface.longDescription: Reports lifecycle state plus bounded messages and tool activity/results to the private term-server session broker. Retained history is available only to the capability-checked Supervisor CLI and the integration is inactive outside term-server.
defaultPrompt: Show live Codex activity in term-server.
